latestVersion.changelog:
- Clarifies that the skill provides guidance and templates only, with no requirement to execute third-party code.
- Updates account onboarding instructions to focus on documentation-based guidance rather than direct automation.
- Marks CLI and Telegram bots as optional external examples, requiring explicit user approval before any code execution.
